intro: Offered by Harb Clawhoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, this transaction allows seasoned riders to exchange an aging Teal Kodo for a great brown, gray or white kodo from the newer herds. It represents the careful breeding and husbandry practiced by tauren kodo handlers across the plains.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you bring me your aging kodo, I will trade it in for one from the new herd. The new kodo will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the great kodos we already have around the yard here to see what you will have to choose from.
